# Calculate 52^12
number = 52 ** 12

# Convert to string to access individual digits
number_str = str(number)

# Print the number itself for verification
print(f"52^12 = {number}")

# Sum all the digits
digit_sum = sum(int(digit) for digit in number_str)

# Print the answer
print(f"Sum of digits: {digit_sum}")
EOF
